company: Grind & Crumb, fictional 12-store independent café chain (Sheffield, Leeds, York, Manchester, Nottingham, Harrogate, Hull). Data covers 1 Jul 2025 to 30 Jun 2026. Board has £1.5m to invest next year.
ground_rules: All prices and sales net of VAT
Delivery: platform commission on order value + £0.45 packaging per order + ~4 min staff time
Compare stores on store-level profit; ignore head office and tax
key_events: Leeds Trinity opened 15 Sep 2025, 0.4 miles from Briggate
App v3.0 launched 2 Mar 2026; v3.1 hotfix 13 Apr 2026

findings.problem: Lunch understaffing at Piccadilly and Spinningfields
findings.root_cause: Lunch rotas cover ~27 customers per staff hour vs ~18 elsewhere, so 1 in 5 lunch visitors walk out; burnout drives staff turnover
findings.impact_basis: Lost lunch sales if conversion matched the chain median (Piccadilly ~£62k, Spinningfields ~£48k); sales, not profit
findings.evidence: Lunch conversion 28.8% vs 36% elsewhere; exit survey: workload is the top reason; 27-35% of reviews mention queues/staff; Piccadilly turnover 230%

findings.problem: Piccadilly loses money despite the biggest sales
findings.root_cause: Rent of £30.5k/month is 33% of sales vs a 12% chain average; the store makes a loss every month
findings.evidence: Starter P&L: -£47.8k profit on £1.11m sales; manager says rent is head office's problem

findings.root_cause: Trinity opened 0.4 miles away; Briggate footfall fell ~29% while the rest of the chain fell only ~5%
findings.impact_basis: Briggate profit fell from £17.4k/month (Jul-Aug) to £7.9k/month (Oct-Jun), annualised
findings.evidence: Briggate footfall 33.9k to 23.9k/month; regulars told the manager they now use the new one; Briggate waste rose with unchanged par levels

findings.root_cause: Delivery doubled from 11% to 23% of sales but keeps only 41% after food, commission and packaging vs 72% in-store; Dashly raised commission to 33% in April
findings.impact_basis: Dashly hike ~£43k/yr plus ~£41k/yr available from a £1.50 small-order fee (assumes 15% of small orders drop)
findings.evidence: 29% of delivery orders are under £8 and earn £0.61-£2.02 each after costs; RushEats suggested a min basket

findings.root_cause: Stamp migration bug and checkout freeze; app orders fell 41% overnight and customers moved to the tills, lengthening queues
findings.impact_basis: Little direct sales loss (orders moved in-store) but it adds to lunch queues and cost loyalty data
findings.evidence: App orders 571/day (Feb) to 337/day (Mar), 425/day by May-Jun; review rating fell from 3.9 to 3.4; 43% of app users say they visit less

findings.root_cause: Broken equipment, no cleaner since October and over-ordering
findings.impact_basis: Excess waste ~£9k + excess repairs ~£16k vs chain medians
findings.evidence: Waste 21% vs 9% chain; repairs £24.2k vs £7.9k median; worst rating 3.05; 25% of reviews mention dirt/broken kit; turnover 178%

findings.root_cause: 40p charge from 12 Jan 2026 while rival Bean Social dropped theirs
findings.impact_basis: Revenue the charge raises (would be lost if dropped); milk-drink volume held, so few sales lost so far
findings.evidence: Oat share fell from 31% to 24%; 53% of oat drinkers say they visit less vs 30% of dairy; ~40 complaints/month in reviews

findings.problem: Campus kiosk loses money outside term
findings.root_cause: Full opening costs through summer and Easter when students are away
findings.impact_basis: Sum of losses in loss-making months (Jul, Aug, Sep, Apr, Jun)
findings.evidence: Sales fall from ~£45k/month in term to ~£13k in summer

data_issues.handling: Excluded from basket and order analysis

data_issues.issue: Flat whites priced £35 (10x) on 14 Mar 2026, York
data_issues.handling: Excluded; likely a till price error

data_issues.issue: Footfall counter dead, Northern Quarter 19-31 Jan 2026

data_issues.handling: Used only for ratios; totals from daily sales
